note: Frozen before any agent run (S5-T10 ruling 2). Questions are written as a person would ask; the answering agent sees only `question` (under a batch-local label Q1..Q6), never the id, the category or the expected outcome. Paths are root/path; lines are 1-based inclusive and name the lines that support the answer in the generation the batch runs on. key_facts: every string must appear in the answer (case-folded); forbidden_in_answer: none may appear in the answer; forbidden_in_transcript: none may appear in any server result of the batch. A category (a) answer names the file; lines are not required.
